module.name: Global Energy Regime Awareness
module.purpose: Passive, descriptive, operator-aligned framework for expressing operating context, validity assumptions, and boundary semantics within global energy systems — covering generation, transmission, distribution, and storage domains without prescribing control or optimization.

submodules.name: Overview
submodules.purpose: Establishes GERA purpose, scope, non-goals, and terminology alignment with substrate-based regime models.

submodules.name: Energy Regimes
submodules.purpose: Defines four canonical operating regimes — steady-state generation, peak demand, renewable variability, and emergency operations.

submodules.name: Grid Entry Points
submodules.purpose: Describes structural entry points into regime awareness — generation assets, transmission networks, distribution systems, and storage and buffering.

submodules.name: Minimal Schema
submodules.purpose: Provides the energy regime awareness schema, example declarations, design notes, and passive grid declaration templates.

submodules.name: Integration Patterns
submodules.purpose: Defines operator context alignment, SCADA observability, and automation boundary markers for regime-aware integration.

submodules.name: Operational Implications
submodules.purpose: Covers grid event interpretation, load shedding context, and post-event analysis within a regime-aware operational model.

files.purpose: Navigation anchor for the GERA domain — introduces the passive descriptive framework, scopes the module, and links all six subdirectories.
